This script includes an Invisible GUI that lets you toggle invisibility ON/OFF, with a clean, draggable interface!

Features:

Invisible Mode — Toggle invisibility on or off through the GUI or by pressing G. Your character becomes partially transparent, with additional positioning behavior designed to make you harder to see..
No-Collide Feature — Disables local collision for other characters while invisibility is enabled.
Modern GUI — Clean design with smooth animations, toggle effects, and notifications.
Minimize & Restore — Minimize the GUI into a floating sphere and tap it to restore the main panel.
Draggable Interface — Move the main GUI and minimized sphere wherever you want.
Close Confirmation — Confirm before closing the GUI.
Respawn Handling — Resets the invisibility state when your character respawns.

Alpha means this script is an early development version. It may still have bugs, incomplete features, or unexpected behavior. More improvements, fixes, and changes may come in future updates.

How to Use:

1. Execute the script.
2. Press the toggle in the GUI or press G to activate/deactivate invisibility.
3. Stand up before enabling invisibility if your character is seated.
4. Minimize the GUI whenever you want a smaller interface.

Notice this script still Alpha A few Bugs may unexpectedly Appear.

-- ==============================================================================
-- SCRIPT MODO PC + TECLADO DE CHAT (COMPATIBLE CON DELTA)
-- ==============================================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Limpiar interfaz anterior si existe
if playerGui:FindFirstChild("TotalPCMode_Ultimate") then
    playerGui.TotalPCMode_Ultimate:Destroy()
end

-- Ocultar controles táctiles originales de Roblox
pcall(function()
    local touchGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    if touchGui then touchGui.Enabled = false end
end)
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child.Name == "TouchGui" then child.Enabled = false end
end)

local function getHumanoid()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "TotalPCMode_Ultimate"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 999999
ScreenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainControlsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainControlsFrame.Name = "MainControlsFrame"
mainControlsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
mainControlsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainControlsFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local function makeButton(name, text, size, pos, parent, color)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Size = size
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.AutoButtonColor = true

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    corner.Parent = btn

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    stroke.Parent = btn

    btn.Parent = parent or mainControlsFrame
    return btn
end

local function simulateKey(keyCode)
    if VirtualInputManager then
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
        task.delay(0.05, function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
        end)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CÁMARA Y DISPARO TÁCTIL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local camZone = Instance.new("TextButton")
camZone.Name = "MouseTouchpad"
camZone.Text = ""
camZone.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0.75, 0)
camZone.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.05, 0)
camZone.BackgroundTransparency = 1
camZone.Parent = mainControlsFrame

local draggingCam = false
local lastPos = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local sensitivity = 0.007

camZone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        draggingCam = true
        lastPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    end
end)

camZone.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if draggingCam and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local currentPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        local delta = currentPos - lastPos
        lastPos = currentPos
        
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            local xAngle = -delta.X * sensitivity
            local yAngle = -delta.Y * sensitivity
            local currentCFrame = cam.CFrame
            local newCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, xAngle, 0) * currentCFrame * CFrame.Angles(yAngle, 0, 0)
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentCFrame.Position, currentCFrame.Position + newCFrame.LookVector)
        end
    end
end)

camZone.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        draggingCam = false
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D-PAD DE MOVIMIENTO (WASD)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local keysPressed = { W = false, A = false, S = false, D = false }
local keyMap = { W = Enum.KeyCode.W, A = Enum.KeyCode.A, S = Enum.KeyCode.S, D = Enum.KeyCode.D }

local dpadFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
dpadFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 160)
dpadFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.03, 0, 0.55, 0)
dpadFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
dpadFrame.Parent = mainControlsFrame

local btnW = makeButton("Key_W", "W", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 0), dpadFrame)
local btnA = makeButton("Key_A", "A", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 52), dpadFrame)
local btnS = makeButton("Key_S", "S", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 104), dpadFrame)
local btnD = makeButton("Key_D", "D", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 108, 0, 52), dpadFrame)

local function setupKeyEvents(btn, keyName)
    local keyCode = keyMap[keyName]
    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            keysPressed[keyName] = true
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.0
            if VirtualInputManager and keyCode then VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game) end
        end
    end)
    btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            keysPressed[keyName] = false
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
            if VirtualInputManager and keyCode then VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game) end
        end
    end)
end

setupKeyEvents(btnW, "W")
setupKeyEvents(btnA, "A")
setupKeyEvents(btnS, "S")
setupKeyEvents(btnD, "D")

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if not hum or not hum.Parent or not hum.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    if keysPressed.W then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
    if keysPressed.S then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
    if keysPressed.A then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
    if keysPressed.D then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
    
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera and moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveVector = moveVector.Unit
        local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local forward = Vector3.new(camCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, camCFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
        local right = Vector3.new(camCFrame.RightVector.X, 0, camCFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit
        local worldDirection = (forward * -moveVector.Z) + (right * moveVector.X)
        hum:Move(worldDirection, false)
    else
        hum:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), false)
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TECLADO VIRTUAL DE CHAT FLOTANTE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local chatKeyboardFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
chatKeyboardFrame.Name = "CustomChatKeyboard"
chatKeyboardFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.42, 0)
chatKeyboardFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.55, 0)
chatKeyboardFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
chatKeyboardFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = false
chatKeyboardFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local kbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
kbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
kbCorner.Parent = chatKeyboardFrame

local inputDisplay = Instance.new("TextLabel")
inputDisplay.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.18, 0)
inputDisplay.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.04, 0)
inputDisplay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
inputDisplay.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
inputDisplay.TextSize = 14
inputDisplay.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
inputDisplay.Text = ""
inputDisplay.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
inputDisplay.Parent = chatKeyboardFrame

local closeKbBtn = makeButton("CloseKB", "❌", UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.18, 0), UDim2.new(0.83, 0, 0.04, 0), chatKeyboardFrame, Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40))

local keysLayout = {
    {"Q","W","E","R","T","Y","U","I","O","P"},
    {"A","S","D","F","G","H","J","K","L"},
    {"Z","X","C","V","B","N","M","←"}
}

local currentMessage = ""

local function updateChatDisplay()
    inputDisplay.Text = "  " .. currentMessage .. "_"
end

local function sendChatMessage(msg)
    if msg == "" or string.gsub(msg, " ", "") == "" then return end
    pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if generalChannel then generalChannel:SendAsync(msg) end
        else
            ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
end

local keyContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
keyContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.96, 0, 0.72, 0)
keyContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.25, 0)
keyContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
keyContainer.Parent = chatKeyboardFrame

for rIndex, row in ipairs(keysLayout) do
    local rowFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    rowFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.23, 0)
    rowFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, (rIndex - 1) * 0.25, 0)
    rowFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    rowFrame.Parent = keyContainer

    local keyWidth = 1 / #row
    for kIndex, char in ipairs(row) do
        local btn = makeButton("K_"..char, char, UDim2.new(keyWidth - 0.01, 0, 0.9, 0), UDim2.new((kIndex - 1) * keyWidth, 0, 0, 0), rowFrame, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55))
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if char == "←" then
                currentMessage = string.sub(currentMessage, 1, #currentMessage - 1)
            else
                currentMessage = currentMessage .. string.lower(char)
            end
            updateChatDisplay()
        end)
    end
end

local spaceBtn = makeButton("K_Space", "ESPACIO", UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.2, 0), UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.78, 0), keyContainer, Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65))
spaceBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    currentMessage = currentMessage .. " "
    updateChatDisplay()
end)

local sendBtn = makeButton("K_Send", "ENVIAR ↵", UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.2, 0), UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.78, 0), keyContainer, Color3.fromRGB(30, 120, 50))
sendBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    sendChatMessage(currentMessage)
    currentMessage = ""
    updateChatDisplay()
    chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = false
end)

closeKbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BARRA SUPERIOR (1-9, CHAT, ESC, INVENTARIO)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local topBarFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
topBarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, 35)
topBarFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.01, 0)
topBarFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topBarFrame.Parent = mainControlsFrame

    Enum.KeyCode.One, Enum.KeyCode.Two, Enum.KeyCode.Three,
    Enum.KeyCode.Four, Enum.KeyCode.Five, Enum.KeyCode.Six,
    Enum.KeyCode.Seven, Enum.KeyCode.Eight, Enum.KeyCode.Nine

for i = 1, 9 do
    local btnNum = makeButton("Key_"..i, tostring(i), UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * 30, 0, 0), topBarFrame)
    btnNum.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        simulateKey(keyCodesNum[i])
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = getHumanoid()
        if not char or not hum then return end
        
        local tools = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(tools, item) end end
        for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(tools, item) end end
        
        local targetTool = tools[i]
        if targetTool then
            local currentTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if currentTool == targetTool then
                hum:UnequipTools()
            else
                hum:EquipTool(targetTool)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local btnChat = makeButton("Btn_Chat", "💬", UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, 275, 0, 0), topBarFrame, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 100))
btnChat.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = not chatKeyboardFrame.Visible
    if chatKeyboardFrame.Visible then

        updateChatDisplay()

local btnEsc = makeButton("Btn_Esc", "⚙️", UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, 315, 0, 0), topBarFrame, Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80))
btnEsc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

local btnInv = makeButton("Btn_Inv", "🎒", UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, 355, 0, 0), topBarFrame, Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 40))

    StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.TouchControls, false)
end)

    GuiService.TouchControlsEnabled = false
end)

    if not UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled then
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true

    if not bodyPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    
    local clone = bodyPart:Clone()
    clone.Anchored = true
    clone.CanCollide = false
    clone.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    clone.Color = TrailColor
    clone.Transparency = 0.4
    
    for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
        if not child:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    
    clone.Parent = workspace
    
    local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(clone, TweenInfo.new(DASH_DURATION, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
        Transparency = 1,
        Size = clone.Size * 0.9
    })
    
    fadeTween:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(clone, DASH_DURATION)
end

local function performJaronaDash()
    if onCooldown or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    onCooldown = true
    
    DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
    DashButton.Text = "CD"

    local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
    if moveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
        moveDirection = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
    end
    
    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection.Unit * DASH_SPEED
    bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart
    
    local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
    bodyGyro.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-65), 0, 0)
    bodyGyro.D = 100
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart

    local trailActive = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while trailActive do
            for _, limb in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if limb:IsA("BasePart") and limb.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    spawnTrailClone(limb)
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(DASH_DURATION)
    bodyVelocity:Destroy()
    bodyGyro:Destroy()
    trailActive = false
    
    task.wait(COOLDOWN)
    DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
    DashButton.Text = "DASH\nQ"
    onCooldown = false
end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then

    end
end)

end)

CloseHelp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    HelpPanel.Visible = false
end)

    character = newCharacter
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end)

    bar.Text = ""
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 47, 62)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.AutoButtonColor = false
    bar.Parent = holder

    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Name = "AccentFill"
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(
        (initial - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0
    )
    fill.Parent = bar

    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(fill.Size.X.Scale, 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = bar

    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local value = initial

    local function setFromX(x)
        local width = bar.AbsoluteSize.X
        if width <= 0 then return end

        local alpha = math.clamp(
            (x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1
        )

        value = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * alpha
        value = math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5) / 100

        local shown = value
        if maxVal > 5 then
            shown = math.floor(value + 0.5)
        end

        fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
        label.Text = labelText .. "  •  " .. tostring(shown)

        callback(value)
    end

    label.Text = labelText .. "  •  " .. tostring(initial)

    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            activeSlider = bar
            setFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if activeSlider == bar and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            setFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            activeSlider = nil
        end
    end)

    return holder
end

local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPosition

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input == dragInput
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

minimize.Activated:Connect(function()

local function updateButton(button, name, enabled)
    if not button then return end

    button.Text = name .. "     [" .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF") .. "]"
    button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(36, 57, 88)
        or Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 48)
end

local hoverButton = makeButton("AUTO HOVER  [OFF]")
local sideButton = makeButton("SIDE TELEPORT  [OFF]")
local equipButton = makeButton("AUTO EQUIP SLOT 1  [OFF]")
local respawnButton = makeButton("AUTO RETURN ON RESPAWN  [OFF]")

local status = makeLabel("STATUS  •  Ready")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 30)

hoverButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not hoverEnabled then
        if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        hoverEnabled = true
    else
        hoverEnabled = false

        if getRoot() then
            anchorPosition = root.Position
            sideOffset = 0
        end
    end

    updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", hoverEnabled)
end)

sideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not sideEnabled then
        if not anchorPosition then
            if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        end

        sideEnabled = true
        sideOffset = 0
        sideSign = 1
        sideTimer = 0
    else
        sideEnabled = false
        sideOffset = 0
    end

    updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", sideEnabled)
end)

equipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    equipEnabled = not equipEnabled
    updateButton(equipButton, "AUTO EQUIP SLOT 1", equipEnabled)

respawnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    autoReturnEnabled = not autoReturnEnabled

    updateButton(
        respawnButton,
        "AUTO RETURN ON RESPAWN",
        autoReturnEnabled

        and "STATUS  •  Auto return enabled"
        or "STATUS  •  Auto return disabled"

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    characterGeneration += 1
    local thisGeneration = characterGeneration

    -- Stop movement using the previous character.
    stopMovement()

    character = char
    humanoid = nil
    root = nil

    status.Text = "STATUS  •  Waiting for character"

    task.spawn(function()
        local newHumanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        local newRoot = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

        if thisGeneration ~= characterGeneration then
            return
        end

        if not newHumanoid or not newRoot then
            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Character unavailable"
            return
        end

        humanoid = newHumanoid
        root = newRoot
        backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

        if autoReturnEnabled and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            -- Use the new spawn point as the anchor.
            anchorPosition = root.Position

            local look = root.CFrame.RightVector
            sideDirection = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)

            if sideDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                sideDirection = Vector3.xAxis
            else
                sideDirection = sideDirection.Unit
            end

            sideOffset = 0
            sideSign = 1
            sideTimer = 0

            -- Resume hovering with the selected height.
            hoverEnabled = true
            sideEnabled = false

            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", true)
            updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", false)

            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Returning to sky"
        else
            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", false)
            updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", false)

            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Respawned"
        end
    end)
end)

if player.Character then

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not alive then return end

    if hoverEnabled or sideEnabled then
        if not getRoot() or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            stopMovement()

            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", false)
            updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", false)

            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Waiting for character"
            return
        end

        if not anchorPosition then
            if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        end

        if sideEnabled then
            sideTimer += dt

            if sideTimer >= interval then
                sideTimer %= interval
                sideSign = -sideSign
                sideOffset = distance * sideSign
            end
        else
            sideOffset = 0
        end

        local targetPosition =
            anchorPosition
            + Vector3.new(0, hoverEnabled and height or 0, 0)
            + sideDirection * sideOffset

        -- Client-side character positioning.
        local rotation = root.CFrame - root.Position
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition) * rotation

        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        status.Text = "STATUS  •  "
            .. (hoverEnabled and "Hovering" or "Ground mode")
            .. (sideEnabled and " / Side movement" or "")
    end

    -- Automatically equip the first available Tool.
    if equipEnabled then
        equipTimer += dt

        if equipTimer >= 0.25 then
            equipTimer = 0

            if getRoot() and humanoid.Health > 0 and backpack then
                local equippedTool =
                    character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

                if not equippedTool then
                    for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                        if item:IsA("Tool") then
                            pcall(function()
                                humanoid:EquipTool(item)
                            end)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
